scope: Expose the already-authorized runtime15 gateway enrollment through a bounded production gateway-control adapter using existing one-time locator/secret and submitted Ed25519 key. No new database grant, login, identity, table or immutable SQL rewrite. This is Device enrollment, not authentic Agent-to-Device association.

authenticate.current_checks: Registered original zasp_gateway_control login, format1, exact enrollment audience, digest locator lookup and domain-separated salted secret hash, current live pending/active Device, token notrevoked/notexpired/latest generation. Original15 token expiry uses transaction timestamp; current80 live replacement uses clock_timestamp and organization serialization.

enroll.original_nine_argument_abi: locator bytea, secret bytea, audience text, credential text, generation bigint, keyID text, algorithm text, publicKey bytea, expires timestamptz
enroll.scope: Derived only from original authenticate result; not supplied to SQL by HTTP caller.
enroll.receipt_is_not_commit_proof: SQL JSONB can precede actual transaction COMMIT; only successful COMMIT permits HTTP200.

existing_abi.privilege: Original0015 GRANT EXECUTE already grants both functions and current credential authority to zasp_gateway_control. Actual registered login/pool must be retained; no SET ROLE, direct table reads or grant expansion.
existing_abi.current80: Original authenticate replacement acquires current organization authority before device advisory, rechecks after wait, then locks token and Device rows; token expiry wallclock check follows waits. ReadCommitted required. gateway_enroll body itself is not replaced by this80 file and inherits authenticate locks/checks.

replay_expiry.exact_replay: gateway_enroll first authenticates current token; consumed=true is accepted only if retained credential for same scoped Device/enrollment matches enrollment_digest of scope, enrollmentID, requestedcredentialID/generation/keyID/algorithm/publickey/expiresmicroseconds. Original issued_at stable, replayed=true. No newDeviceversion increment on replay.
replay_expiry.changed_request: Retained different semantic enrollment digest rejects23505. Fresh enrollment needs not-consumed token, exact next credentialgeneration=max+1, and no other format1 unrevoked credential.
replay_expiry.token_after_success: Consumption alone does not invalidate exact retry, but expiry/revoke/newer enrollment generation does. No expiry bypass or historical consumed-token resurrection.
replay_expiry.credential_expiry_gap: Requested credential expiry validation remains transaction_timestamp in originalenroll (future and <=90days). After blocking auth/device waits it may already expire by wallclock. Proposed adapter must compare actual credential expiry against database clock_timestamp in final confirmation before COMMIT. Existing HTTP Authority also requires whole-second UTC credential expiry, so bootstrap request chooses whole-second UTC.
replay_expiry.unknown_commit: Return no success on commit/context ambiguity. Preserve same privatekey+credentialID/generation/keyID/requestedexpiry/rawbody and retry using same token while current. Token expiry may prevent replay resolution; report outcome UNKNOWN, never never-committed or automatically issue changed intent. Operator recovery can use existing signed current Authority with the preserved key, but must not fabricate an enrollment receipt/first-commit claim.

proposed_http.transport: HTTPS production endpoint; no query, escaped path aliases, redirects or forwarded/caller scope headers. application/json, exact closed keys, maximum4096 bytes; no null/duplicate/casealias/unknown/trailing/invalidUTF8 or UTF16 JSON. Fixed bounded operation deadline. No cookies/session/Stytch token replaces enrollment bearer.
proposed_http.optional_activation: Optional dedicated repository/handler capability selected from original pool before cached legacy interface wrapping; off by default. Bootstrap route must branch before ordinary Device-credential HTTP authentication because no credential exists yet. Existing signed Authority/Policy/Decision/installation routes and global readiness unchanged.
proposed_http.authorization: Proposed closed Authorization: ZaspGatewayEnrollmentV1 <canonicalRawURLlocator22>.<canonicalRawURLsecret43>. Exactly one header, decoded lengths16/32, no token in URL/body/response/log/metrics/traces. This is a proposed transport encoding, not a claimed existing gateway token codec.
proposed_http.proof_of_new_key_possession: Recommended required existing request-signing context/timestamp/bodyhash/signature headers, verified with publickey from strict submitted body and credentialID from samebody. Existing canonicalRequest binds method/host/path/query/credentialID/freshwholeUTCtimestamp/bodyhash; verify using supplied Ed25519 key without querying current Authority first. Enrollment locator/secret remains sole original authorization; proof only demonstrates new key possession/intent. A dedicated bootstrap signer must preserve enrollment Authorization instead of calling existing SignRequest unmodified, which writes Device authorization.
proposed_http.body_validation: All six productIDs canonical; expected org/work/env/device/enrollment/tokenGeneration must equal original authenticated authority and are constraints, not granted caller scope. Both generations positive<=MaxInt64. keyID original regex, algorithm exactlyEd25519, publickey canonicalRawURL32bytes, expires canonicalwholeUTCsecond. Do not accept server-generated default IDs/generation/key or changeexpiry on retries.
proposed_http.receipt: Strict <=4096 application/json, Cache-Control:no-store, HTTP200 only after successful COMMIT. Scope/enrollment/gen from authenticated SQL; credential/key/expiry from strict enrolled and final credential authority matching requested intent. request_sha256 hashes original exactbody. issued_at/expires_at canonicalUTC up to6fractiondigits (wholeexpiry required); replayed retained presentation only, never first-ever commit guarantee. No locator/secret/privatekey returned.
proposed_http.errors: Uniform generic authentication rejection for wrong/missing/expired/revoked/newer-token cases; malformed bounded body400, route/media404or415 chosen consistently, current catalog/backend/unknowncommit503. No raw SQL errors, token existence oracle, body/header/key dumps or unbounded echo. Validly authenticated changed intent may409 without exposing other tuple state; exact error map requires grouped review.

proposed_transaction.pool: Borrow BeginTx(ReadCommitted) from same original gateway-control pool. Shared exported production helper for live adapter and later native application fixture; no duplicate fixture SQL/alternate role helper.
steps: Strict parse and proof verification before Begin; authenticate original locator/secret in transaction.
Compare all expected scope/enrollment/tokenGeneration constraints; never SQL caller-supplied orgscope.
Call exact original gateway_enroll fixedABI with requested tuple; strictly decode and compare retained receipt.

Final fixed queries: reauthenticate enrollment; read current credential authority via existing original function; read database clock_timestamp. Compare bound scope/device/enrollment/tokenGeneration, consumed=true, samecredential/key/publickey/generation/expiry and expiry>databasewallclock; compare enrolled immutable fields and originalissuedtime. Original transaction holds organization/advisory/token/device locks until COMMIT.
If any check/read/context fails rollback with bounded cancellation-independent cleanup. COMMIT must return success and context remain valid before200. Unknown commit has no receipt ACK.
proposed_transaction.final_query_note: Use existing granted functions plus built-in clock_timestamp in fixed SELECT(s), no new SQL function/grant. Ensure function evaluation/clock ordering is explicit (sequential final authenticate, credential authority, THEN clock read) and no further potentially blocking application query follows final clock validation. Clock can pass during network COMMIT; this defines admission at last authoritative check, not perpetual credential validity.

grouped_acceptance: Exact original SQL success/replay/currenttokenboundaries and changedintent conflicts; no native rolehelper replacement.
Actual TLS bootstrap route with original bearer+freshnewkeyproof; strictbody/headers/size, caller scope injection,wrongkey/bodymutation and no credential prerequisite.
Samepool preauth/enroll/finalreauth/currentauthority/DBwallclock/commit with unknowncommit no200; expiry and revocation across actual organization/device/token waits.
Actual CLI pendingkey/request durability, unknown retry sameintent, no regenerated IDs/expiry/privatekey, atomic resulting runtimecredential config and current signed Authority confirmation.
Legacy signed routes/health, tenant denial, no-secret logs, deployment explicit consumer and real deployed Stytch/provider launch flows remain required.
